drift_events.summary: Briefing said 3 pending changesets; there were 4 (olive-moons-repeat.md landed in the most recent commit). Runbook rewritten against the real set.

Plan §D.3 called for 3 synthetic 'first release, no functional change' changesets for estimai-ui/admin-ui/notify-ui. Dropped: the Frontend work genuinely modifies all five frontends, so one real changeset supersedes them and avoids a double-bump. Same approved outcome (all 5 leave 0.0.0) by a more honest route.

Plan §E's verification grep for the bundled version used double quotes only; the minifier emits backtick template literals, so the plan's literal command is a false negative. Quote-agnostic pattern used instead, and carried into the release-cut verification.

Plan §C assumed vi.mock of the MF bare specifiers would work per-test; in practice it was flaky and order-dependent (ES module cache). Switched to an injected remoteVersionSources prop, matching RemoteMount's existing loader-prop pattern. QE later flagged this as leaving the real path untested — closed in fix round 1.

open_followups: The push-trigger CI leg is a DETECTOR, not a gate — GitHub Actions cannot intercept a push, and this repo has zero merged PRs ever (everything lands via direct push to main). Real pre-merge enforcement needs a branch-protection decision ('Require a pull request before merging'), deliberately left out of scope.

No GitHub Actions workflow runs the frontend test suites at all today (only changeset-check.yml and env-doctor.yml). The new shell integration test also introduces an implicit cross-app dependency: it needs pnpm install in all four remote directories before shell's tests can pass.

Residual test gap accepted by QE: a real browser doing a cross-origin import('estimai/version') with live init()/shared-singleton negotiation is still uncovered. The identical transport path is already proven live for the sibling ./App export (shell/e2e/mf-singleton.spec.ts, remote-failure.spec.ts).
The release is committed and tagged LOCALLY ONLY — nothing pushed. Branch chore/version-release-enforcement, 5 commits, 10 tags.
